description: This file contains helper methods for creating and using a generic Writer struct that handles serialization output to various buffer and stream types. It includes methods for writing primitive data types and variable-length integers, managing buffer allocation, and ensuring data is written efficiently for serialization purposes.

classes.name: Writer
classes.description: A generic struct that provides methods for writing data to different buffer or stream implementations, used primarily for serialization output. Supports primitive types, variable-length integers, and buffer management.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory methods to create Writer instances for various output types such as IBufferWriter, MemoryStream, Stream, byte arrays, Memory<byte>, and pooled buffers.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes the underlying buffer writer if it implements IDisposable.

methods.name: Position
methods.description: Returns the current write position within the total data written.

methods.name: WritableSpan
methods.description: Returns the current writable span of bytes in the buffer.

methods.name: AdvanceSpan
methods.description: Advances the write position by a specified number of bytes.

methods.name: Commit
methods.description: Commits the current buffer data, updating internal state.

methods.name: EnsureContiguous
methods.description: Ensures that a specified number of bytes are available for writing, allocating new buffer space if necessary.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates buffer space for a given size hint.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes a ReadOnlySpan<byte> into the buffer, handling multi-segment writes if needed.

methods.name: WriteByte
methods.description: Writes a single byte into the buffer.
